name: empire-frontier
description: Empire Frontier - Dockerized multiplayer 3D browser strategy game

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @empire/shared && npm run build -w @empire/game-data && npm run build -w @empire/game-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @empire/api && npm run build -w @empire/web && npm run build -w @empire/admin
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
